title: [CmdPal] Add tabbed pages to Command Palette

status.label: Review iteration limit reached
status.detail: Seven automated reviews have already been submitted, exceeding the three-iteration limit. One current lifecycle finding remains: cached child initialization can outlive removal and allow an inactive tab to overwrite active command state. A safe correction requires coordinated activation ownership, cancellation or awaiting, and regression coverage; no partial correction or additional review request was made. Focused tabbed-page tests and reported checks remain passing.
